heading_en: Submission of an Application for Approval
summary_ja: 期待エクスポージャー方式の承認申請書の記載事項（商号・責任者）と添付書類（理由書・履歴書・適合性を示す書類・実施計画等）、実施計画の記載事項を定める。
summary_en: Contents of the application to use the expected exposure method — trade name and responsible officer — and the attached documents, including an implementation plan stating scope, start date and planned exclusions.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company seeking the approval under paragraph (1) of the preceding Article for the use of the expected exposure method shall submit to the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency an application for approval stating the following matters. (i) Trade name. (ii) The name and title of the person responsible for ascertaining and managing the consolidated capital adequacy ratio.

The following documents shall be attached to the application for approval in the preceding paragraph. (i) A statement of reasons. (ii) The curriculum vitae of the person responsible provided in item (ii) of the preceding paragraph. (iii) Documents showing that the construction, use and other operation of the expected exposure model conform to the standards for approval. (iv) An implementation plan for the expected exposure method. (v) Documents stating other matters for reference.

The implementation plan for the expected exposure method listed in item (iv) of the preceding paragraph shall state the following matters. (i) The scope to which the expected exposure method is applied and the date on which application of the method begins. (ii) The scope planned to be excluded from application of the expected exposure method.
